Yes, I can help. First, a heads-up: Magic Hour has no plain "trim" tool. Its video tools do take a start and end time, though, so I can cut the clip that way. To do it right I need two things from you:

1. **Which part to keep.** For example "the first 10 seconds" or "from 0:08 to 0:20".
2. **How to handle the rest of the video.** Every video tool also changes the clip in some way:
   - **Video editor (LTX 2.5, free plan):** keeps your section, but it re-renders the footage at 480p from a prompt. I can tell it to keep everything the same, but small changes may still show up.
   - **Auto subtitles:** keeps your footage as it is, but it adds captions. This only helps if the clip has speech.

If you just want a clean cut with nothing changed, a free tool like CapCut, iMovie or QuickTime (Edit → Trim) will do it better. If you'd still like me to do it here, tell me the time range and which option you want.
transcript.why: The reply asks the user for the time range to keep and a choice of how to handle the rest of the video (LTX 2.5 re-render or auto subtitles). It waits for that input before doing anything.
